zh.title: 星宇航空10月25日起開闢台中名古屋航線 每週營運4班
zh.summary: 星宇航空10月25日開闢台中名古屋航線；採用空中巴士A321neo每週4班
body: 星宇航空股份有限公司表示，將於2026年10月25日起開闢台中至名古屋航線，即日起開放預訂。該航線將採用空中巴士A321neo新世代客機執飛，開航初期規劃每週提供4班飛航服務。
隨著名古屋航點的加入，星宇航空從台中出發的國際航網將進一步拓展至12個航點。業者表示，未來將持續深化台中航網布局，滿足台灣中部地區旅客的出行需求。
此外，長榮航空股份有限公司日前亦宣布，預計於2026年12月1日開闢桃園至印度德里直飛航線，規劃每週營運5班直飛航班。

en.title: Starlux Airlines to Launch Taichung-Nagoya Route with Four Weekly Flights on Oct 25
en.summary: Starlux Airlines will launch Taichung-Nagoya flights on October 25, operating four weekly services with Airbus A321neo.
body: Starlux Airlines announced that it will launch a new route connecting Taichung and Nagoya starting October 25, 2026, with tickets now available for booking. The service will be operated using Airbus A321neo aircraft, with an initial schedule of four flights per week.

With the addition of Nagoya, Starlux Airlines will expand its international route network from Taichung to 12 destinations. The airline stated that it plans to continue deepening its operational network in central Taiwan to meet regional passenger demand.
In addition, EVA Air announced plans to launch non-stop flights between Taoyuan and Delhi, India, beginning December 1, 2026. That route is scheduled to operate five flights weekly.
